description: Read and verify a Constancia de Situación Fiscal. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "rfc/endpoints/csf-verify".

file.description: The constancia as base64: the PDF SAT generated, or a PNG or JPEG image of it. A `data:` URL prefix is accepted. Up to 8 MB.

id_cif.description: The idCIF printed under the taxpayer's name on the constancia's first page.

qr.description: The text of a QR code printed on the constancia (a siat.sat.gob.mx validadorqr URL), or an array with both. The first-page QR returns the taxpayer; the seal QR returns the issue date.

name: csf_verify
title: Read and verify a Constancia de Situación Fiscal
